newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST-Bank of Spain seen holding key rate Tues.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank of Spain seen holding key rate Tues.

text.p: The Bank of Spain will leave its key money rate at 5.75 percent at Tuesday's regular repo auction, according to a poll conducted by Reuters on Monday.
All 10 analysts surveyed said there has been no change in the economic outlook since the central bank trimmed its key money rate by 25 basis points at the last auction on March 14.

But most of those polled agreed there is room for at least a further 25 basis point cut later this year, depending on the performance of inflation --currently at 2.5 percent-- and the peseta's exchange rate.
